career_ladder.note: Sub-Inspectors of Police (Trainee) enter the General Executive Branch of Kerala Police at Pay Scale ₹45,600 - ₹95,600 as Station House Officers (SHO) and frontline supervising officers. The career ladder advances through Inspector of Police, Deputy Superintendent of Police (DySP) / Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP), Superintendent of Police (Non-Cadre), and culminates in induction into the Indian Police Service (IPS) Kerala Cadre under the IPS (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations, 1955.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to Sub-Inspector of Police (Trainee) involves a multi-tier selection process: Common Degree Level Preliminary Examination (Objective OMR screening test carrying 100 marks), Degree Level Main Written Examination (Objective OMR carrying 100 marks), Physical Measurement Test (PMT), Physical Efficiency Test (PET - National Physical Efficiency 1-star standard), and Medical Examination. Final rank list is prepared strictly based on the marks obtained in the Main Written Examination among candidates qualifying all physical and medical standards.

papers.negative_marking: 0.33 mark deducted for each wrong answer

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurement (Male: Height min 167 cm [160 cm for SC/ST], Chest min 81 cm with 5 cm expansion [76 cm with 5 cm expansion for SC/ST]; Female: Height min 160 cm [155 cm for SC/ST])
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying standard; candidate must fulfill prescribed minimum height and chest measurements

papers.paper_name: PET Events (Male: Must qualify in min 5 of 8 events: 100m in 14.0s, High Jump 132.2cm, Long Jump 457.2cm, Shot Put 609.6cm, Cricket Ball Throw 6096cm, Rope Climbing 365.8cm, Pull-ups 8 times, 1500m in 5m 44s; Female: min 5 of 8 events)

stages.source_label: Kerala Police Academy & Medical Board Standards

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors of Police in Kerala Police are remunerated under the Kerala State 11th Pay Revision (G.O.(P) No. 27/2021/Fin) at Pay Scale ₹45,600 - ₹95,600 with entry basic pay of ₹45,600.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Kerala PSC Gazette Notification Cat. No. 669/2022 & Kerala Police Headquarters Pay Rules
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Kerala State 11th Pay Revision entry basic pay of ₹45,600 with standard 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025, ₹26,448) plus House Rent Allowance (Class A Corporation ₹4,560, Class B ₹3,200, Class C ₹2,500), Police Special Duty/Investigation allowance (₹1,500/month), and Uniform allowance; net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic+DA = ₹7,205), MEDISEP health insurance (₹500/month), State Life Insurance (SLI), Police Welfare Fund, and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Government designated police residential quarters at station / circle headquarters
Official department vehicle (patrol jeep / motorcycle) for station and investigation duties
Comprehensive medical coverage under the Kerala Government MEDISEP scheme
Investigation allowance, mobile phone allowance, and uniform kit maintenance grants
Police Department Welfare and Benevolent Fund coverage for officer and family
